examples.english: They're so cowardly they won't even go into a haunted house.

examples.english: They have always been timid and never dare speak when they see strangers.

examples.english: I'm shy and don't dare walk alone at night.
examples.traditional: 我好膽小，夜晚唔敢自己行街。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 daam2 siu2 je6 maan5 m4 gam2 zi6 gei2 haang4 gaai1
